item: row 367: the Sources section follows a language switch
summary: Eight app-sources.js renderers held through ooLive/ooLiveHtml: the filter summaries (Any, N selected), the AI check's busy word, result line (canary warning first) and label, the source trail panel (a drill list opened inside lets the hold go), the import's unreadable-country sentence in its own node, the single and batch feed results with their hovers and the batch table (its headers now keyed), the batch picker's empty, failed and capped lines, and the retired-mode notice. The two result lines with a hover are held as HTML, so the line is marked and its hover is the render's rather than the walker's; the trail's drill list is held with its hover keyed. Older bug fixed on the way: importSources called a tf that does not exist on the page, so an import with unreadable countries read as failed after its rows were stored. Driven as real code; 26 of 27 mutations caught, the last one equivalent (the capped line's release before a foreign write).
